info.title: API.SH: BuildZoom
info.description: The BuildZoom API from API.SH: public BuildZoom data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: BuildZoom contractor profile: score, licences, permits, reviews
get.description:
One contractor's BuildZoom profile: id (for the permits route), name, type, business phone and address, description, logo, services, rating and review count, BuildZoom score, badge, percentile and note, total permits, permitted projects by year, project types and job-value spread (with the site's notes), licence credentials (number, type, issuing board, where valid) and licence records (status, county or state, business type, expiry), employees and owners as listed, client reviews (author as first name and initial, date, verified hire, subject, rating, text) and a sample of 20 permits (title, address, date, description, valuation, permit number, status, fee, permit and building type).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/buildzoom-contractor

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A contractor's building permits, 20 per page, by notability (score) or date: title, job address, date, description, valuation, permit number, status, fee, permit and building type, and the property page link. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/buildzoom-contractor-permits

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: score (default, most notable first) or date (newest first).

get.summary: BuildZoom contractor search by city and trade with every listing filter
get.description:
US contractors on BuildZoom for a city (or ZIP code) and trade: id, slug, name, BuildZoom score and level, caution note, claimed / elite / licensed flags, licence numbers and types, insured and bonded amounts, city and state, residential / commercial work, business phone, rating and review count, permitted projects and median job value, about text, photo and project-type counts. Filter by radius (city, 10, 25 or 50 miles), residential or commercial work, average project value, and contractors with reviews, verified projects or photos; sort like the site. The site lists at most 10 pages: up to 25 per page, pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/buildzoom-contractors

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City as "Austin, TX" or a BuildZoom city slug (austin-tx); give location or zip.

parameters.name: project_value
parameters.description: Average project value: max10k, max50k, max100k or min100k.

parameters.name: has_reviews
parameters.description: true: only contractors with client reviews.

parameters.name: has_permits
parameters.description: true: only contractors with verified projects.

parameters.name: has_photos
parameters.description: true: only contractors with project photos.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (top 10 first), buildzoom_score, num_permits, avg_review_score or median_job_value.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: BuildZoom location for a ZIP code
get.description:
The BuildZoom city for a US ZIP code: city slug, city, state, coordinates and the matched ZIP. Unknown ZIP codes answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/buildzoom-location

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every contractor type BuildZoom lists (general contractors, architects, roofers, plumbers...) with id, slug and name. Use the slug as `trade` in /buildzoom/v1/contractors.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/buildzoom-trades

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
